chapters.title: Chapter 1161: You Spoil Them Too Much!!!
paragraphs: In the Castle’s library, specifically the Manga area, three red-haired heads were gathered in the corner, where there was a sofa, a rug, and a fireplace. The place was filled with manga, and books were scattered messily, a very comfortable and cozy place for anyone who just wanted to spend time having fun.
"Did you hear?"
"Hear what?"
"My mother joined the Empire’s project!!! And if she joins, that means there’s a greater chance that I’ll join too!"
"What!? Why didn’t I hear about this?"
Priscilla Penny Elderblood, the shameless copy of Pepper and Victor, has her mother’s enthusiasm and her father’s cunning.
"You don’t check the updates frequently, Sylvia." Rosemary Lavina Elderblood, daughter of Ruby and Victor, spoke.
"Who wastes time reading that? The session updates every second!" Sylvia Elderblood, daughter of Victor and Siena, grumbled.
"I read it," Rosemary said.
"Me too." Priscilla agreed.
"Nerds." Sylvia snorted.
"Stop being lazy, with our brains, we can read all of that in less than a minute." Rosemary snorted.
"Forget Sylvia’s laziness!!!" Priscilla interrupted.
"Hey, I’m not lazy!"
Ignoring Sylvia, she continued: "The important thing now is that my mother is on the project!!! And I will join." She finished seriously.
"Don’t ignore me!"
"... What are you going to do?" Rosemary narrowed her eyes.
"Join the project, of course!" Priscilla nodded, satisfied.
"Okay, and how are you going to do that?" She insisted.
Priscilla hesitated: "... I haven’t thought about that part yet, but I’ll get there."
"Don’t ignore me!" Sylvia growled. "And to begin with, Mother Velnorah, Mother Aline, Mother Ruby won’t let you participate."
"It’s not fair! Velina is also participating."
"Velina is ridiculously competent, and she has worked with Mother since she was little... Something you should be doing, Rose." Sylvia narrowed her eyes at her sister.

Rosemary just shrugged: "I don’t like scientific matters." It’s not that she was dumb, none of them were. After all, her biology was simply incompatible with being truly stupid, and even the most inattentive of their siblings could read a seriously complex scientific paper. They could understand such things instinctively, and they all had royal-level educations, an education that covered all fields. Their parents made sure to put their draconic brains to work, and everything after that was purely a matter of taste.

Unlike Ruby, who developed a taste for experiments and the more scientific side of things over time, Rosemary was a Ruby who did not need to go through all these difficulties and just enjoyed herself.

She preferred reading manga, watching anime and movies, and training rather than staying in a laboratory. Her minimum goal is to inherit one of the legions or become the commander of one. After all, every daughter’s desire was to help her father in the Empire in some way.

’Let the more complicated parts be left to the sisters who like it. I will do something else~’ This was Rosemary’s thought on the matter. With so many competent sisters, she did not feel any pressure or difficulty.
"Hmm, I have an idea."
"And that’s not a good idea," Sylvia snarked.
"Good people, follow my lead! I will join this project today!"
"... Priscilla, you don’t even know which project our mother is in, and if we don’t know, that means it is a very secret project. I highly doubt you will manage to join."

After all, the information bank only said Pepper joined a project but didn’t specify which one yet, and this database was exclusive to the royal family. If there was no information about the matter in the Empire’s database, that means whatever Pepper joined was being treated as an imperial secret. So if the daughters want to know about the matter, they need to go to one of the mothers who had authority to see this data.

Victor usually left most of the Imperial secrets for the daughters to read as a way to encourage them to participate more in the family business. At first glance, it may seem like a security risk to leave such valuable information in the hands of ’children’, but that wasn’t true. The most well-protected people in the Empire were the Imperial family, and every time one of his daughters went out into the outside world, she was accompanied by several Imperial Guards, and even some personal forces of Victor himself. Not to mention that, despite how they act together, outside they behave as they were taught to be: a true Imperial Princess.

Therefore, he does not care about them reading everything about the Empire, but there are still things they cannot see, things like Polaris, which was a trump card of the Empire. He hid it completely, and even most of his wives do not know about it. Only those involved in the project and the two Empresses knew.
When something was a trump card, the best thing was for fewer people to know so as not to risk the information leaking.
"...." Priscilla stopped walking when she realized that her sister was right.
"Fuee... What should I do?" She grumbled.
"Why don’t you forget this and try to join another project?" Sylvia suggested.
"No! If my mother joined, that means I am qualified too!" Priscilla refused to let the matter go.
"Well, we tried," Rosemary said and then returned to her reading.
Priscilla remained silent for a full ten minutes.
Sylvia approached Rosemary and commented quietly: "This is not a good sign."
"I know..."

When her hyperactive sister remained silent for so long, it meant that she was thinking deeply and using her brain to the maximum, a draconic brain that came integrated with her biology, a brain that made quantum computers look like sophisticated toys.
Another 20 minutes passed.
Rosemary and Sylvia were slowly breaking into a cold sweat, and soon they could no longer concentrate on their respective books.
"... I had an idea." A literal lightbulb rose above Priscilla’s head.
’I really want to know, but at the same time I don’t.’ Rosemary and Sylvia thought at the same time, their instincts telling them not to get involved in this, or it would end badly for them.
"I’ll be right back!"
"...." Looking at where their sister disappeared, the two redheads looked at each other.
"... What do we do?" Rosemary asked.
"I don’t know, but one thing is certain. This will end badly, right?" Sylvia spoke.
"Yes." Rosemary nodded. There was no doubt, and it was only a matter of time before things went wrong.
The two sighed, and soon after got up.
"Let’s follow her," Rosemary said.
"Yes."

If they hadn’t heard about the matter, they could have ignored what happened, but they’d participated in the conversation and knew that Priscilla would do something. As sisters, they would not leave their sister alone. That was not how this family worked.

Each one may have her own distinct or even problematic personality, but if there was something all the sisters had in common, it was that they were very close. Messing with one sister is like messing with all of them.
The two soon disappeared and followed Priscilla’s trail.
Victor’s personal room.

Victor, who was resting a little after the recent meeting he had- not that he needed to- but there were times when he just wanted to be alone and reflect on things. Usually he does this while watching a movie or playing video games. He deliberately left his body with the reflexes of a basic human to enjoy the experience. He stopped playing when he felt someone sneaking into the mothers’ area.
Using his powers, Victor smiled gently when he saw this scene of the sisters.
"Just for this display of sisterhood, I would already have let you enter the project, my daughter." Victor laughed lightly.

He kept watching to see what Priscilla would do, as she stealthily approached Pepper’s room in a completely black outfit, like a ninja. She approached the window and began whispering at high speed. Soon, hundreds of draconic runes began to be made.
"Oh? She is ingenious, so the time she spent standing still was to think of ways to get past the defenses of Pepper’s room, as expected of my daughter."
"Pepper is still using the old defenses. She must have been too lazy to update, huh..."

Normally, in Victor’s personal world, such protections were effectively useless. After all, no one could enter that place without his direct permission. But living in a family full of super beings with incredible senses could be inconvenient sometimes. So several girls made protections for privacy. The most protected place was the area where Victor and the wives lived.

After all, it was not uncommon for husband and wife to do physical activities that could not be shown to the daughters. And because they were so curious about everything, it was better to avoid that kind of situation.

It was exactly these barriers of Pepper’s that were being broken with the powers of draconic runes, which was an impressive feat for someone so young. Well, as young as a dragon god can be, she was older than several human generations together.
"Her fertile mind helps a lot in mastering runes, and she is at a very high level of mastery." Victor analyzed, satisfied.

’I should increase the defenses of the complex better. If my beautiful daughter can do this, it is very likely that others can too.’ If there was something Victor never underestimated, it was the talent and potential of his daughters; they were monsters.
If the Victor from the beginning, the one who had just become a vampire, faced any of them, he would lose miserably.
’Thinking about it, it is quite ironic, isn’t it? These girls were all born at the top of existence in terms of power, potential, and talent.’ He thought.
Because his daughters were so talented, Scathach never refused when one of them wanted to train, and she took the greatest pleasure in polishing these raw diamonds.
"Ah, she broke it."
Pepper entered her mother’s room stealthily, and it was at this moment that the two sisters arrived.
"Sister, what are you-."
"!!!" Priscilla almost had a heart attack. She quickly approached them and covered their mouths. "Do you want to scare me to death!?" She murmured furiously.

Sylvia and Rosemary looked at where they were and widened their eyes in disbelief, before quickly feeling a deep fear. If they were caught here, forget punishment, Anna would throw them directly into rehabilitation with Scathach! And that rehabilitation lasted a whole year!!!

After all, it was forbidden to invade the mothers’ personal room. If they asked permission from outside, there were no problems, but invade? The lightest punishment was only a harsh reprimand, and a more severe one would be staying with Scathach for training and rehabilitation, which means following a study and training schedule similar to what Victor had in the past, only in a much more elevated version because, as dragon goddesses, they can handle it.

The punishment depended completely on the mothers, and Pepper was generally very lenient as long as it wasn’t something very serious. They would usually leave with a light reprimand, but Pepper was not here! The one in charge of things currently was Anna! And she had no mercy.
"HMMHMMHMMHM!?" Rosemary spoke furiously. [Translation: Are you crazy!?]
"HMMHMMHMMHM!!!" Sylvia spoke furiously. [Translation: She is completely crazy!!!]

chapters.title: Chapter 1162: You Spoil Them Too Much!!! 2
paragraphs: [Why did you follow me!? I didn’t ask for help!!!] Priscilla whispered mentally.
[You are our sister, we will not leave you alone!] Rosemary replied.
[That’s right.] Sylvia confirmed.

[... You guys...] She smiled gently: [Okay! Since you are here, then help me!] Priscilla quickly used her rune powers, bending reality and giving two ninja uniforms identical to hers to the two sisters.
’Using rune powers for something so simple, unbelievable.’ The two thought.

Priscilla did not even need to use this power to give them clothes. All the daughters have something like a game inventory where they store their things. They can simply change clothes at any time. This was a gift that Victor and Natalia gave to everyone. It was a private pocket dimension, an evolution of the old dimensional bag that they sold in the past.
[Look for anything related to the project and the possible location. Mother is very distracted when she is at home, so she usually leaves things lying around.] Priscilla immediately began to work.
"...." Looking at the mess that was Pepper’s room. Sylvia and Rosemary felt a headache coming.

For reference, Pepper’s room was expanded with the power of space. Instead of calling it a room, it was more accurate to call it a super mansion with 2.8 million m2 of land, around 36 times larger than the old Buckingham Palace.

[What are the Maids doing? Why don’t they clean this? Actually, she doesn’t even need a maid. With Mother’s proficiency in runes, she could make runes to fix everything. And why does Mother need such a large place!? Our house is already gigantic! She doesn’t need such a huge space, there’s even a river spring there!] Sylvia grumbled irritably.
This place had everything: its own ecosystem, a waterfall that fell into a river, and an entire forest. It was basically a separate dimension!
"What the hell is this!?"
"...." Sylvia and Rosemary quickly ran after Priscilla.

Heading toward the basement, they entered and felt the dimension change to another, even more reinforced dimension. What they did not know was that the moment they entered this smaller dimension, Pepper was immediately alerted about the matter.
She tried to teleport to her room, but instead, she fell into Victor’s lap.
"Fuee?..." Pepper was confused for an entire second: "Darling!? Why did you stop me?"
"Just watch." Victor laughed as he caressed Pepper’s head.
Pepper narrowed her eyes, enjoying the affection, and quickly hugged him. After charging her V battery for a few seconds, she looked at the image Victor created, which showed her three daughters.
"Ahhh, these three brats invaded my room! Darling, you need to stop them!"
"It’s okay, hahaha, let them have fun for now."
"You spoil them too much, Darling!!! That isn’t healthy!" She grumbled irritably.

"Whoaaa, what the hell is this?" Rosemary spoke incredulously as she looked at a gigantic white sphere made of pure energy. The sphere was floating in the middle of several scientific pieces of equipment that they understood nothing about. Looking at the space around it with the eyes they inherited from their father, they saw thousands of Runes throughout the smaller dimension.
"What the hell was our mother doing here?" Priscilla asked.
"Wait, there must be records somewhere." Sylvia quickly ran to the computers and began messing with them. Soon, she found a work history.

"Fun project: The creation of a supernova in the palm of my hand. Phase 3: I managed to stabilize the star with hundreds of runes and, with the help of a sun divinity that I was recently promoting, I erased her memory afterward. Despite not having complete mastery like my sister Amaterasu, this beginning is already enough to start everything. Phase 4: the star is ready, and it only needs to be fed... I want it to have the power of 1 billion suns exploding!!!"
"Mother, are you crazy!?" Sylvia commented after reading the last part.
"Mother is trying to create an overpowered Sentry or something!?" Priscilla spoke.

"It’s no wonder this is in another dimension, and this dimension is so reinforced. If this star explodes, this entire dimension will swallow the energy, and if the energy passes through, the other dimension will ensure that it does not affect the planet. It is a multilayer protection." Rosemary commented.
"And how the hell did our mother manage this? Wasn’t she just a goddess of fun culture!?" Sylvia spoke.

"In our bloodline, there are no stupid people. Our brains are better than several quantum computers together." Rosemary said, reading the technology behind it on another computer. She read the complex text at high speed, and when she didn’t understand something, she consulted her personal computer, which had access to everything in the Empire, to learn.
In less than a few minutes, she was already beginning to understand the basics of something so advanced that she had never delved into much.

"Ugh, there is too much data. There must be hundreds of millions of compiled research data full of complicated notes that only Mother Pepper makes. There’s no way to learn everything so quickly, our mother must have been doing this for a long time." She grumbled.
"Wait, if our Mother Pepper, who is considered a goddess of culture and does not focus much on science, did this... I wonder what our Mother Velnorah, Aline, and Ruby do?" Sylvia spoke.
The three mentioned were well known for their role in the Empire’s development.
"....." The three remained silent, and the seed of curiosity shone in all of them. At this point, they had already forgotten why they were here.
"... Let’s kidnap Velina."
If there was someone among the sisters who could know what their three mothers were doing, it was Velina. After all, she spent most of her time with the three.
"Agreed."
"Umu, they are indeed my daughters." Victor nodded, satisfied.
"Darling, you have to stop them!"
"Mah, Mah, it’s okay." Victor gently hugged Pepper and began kissing her neck and caressing her.

"S-Stop! You think this will make me ignore what you are doing! You are spoiling them too much!" Pepper spoke seriously, but his hands did not stop, and she was beginning to heat up as her draconic eyes narrowed in visible desire.
"I never said that~, I am just spending time with my beloved wife."
"You are too partial toward them!"

"Haaah~" Pepper shuddered with desire, and she wasted no more time, erasing her husband’s clothes from existence. She raised her hips and quickly lowered them. Soon, she began to fulfill this desire that had been awakened.
Victor quickly isolated the area and made time run slower for them, after all, he knew it would take some time.
"Before that, let’s see if our mother has more things hidden here."
"Let’s go!"

Leaving the pocket dimension, they began to search through the mansion more. They searched the entire place using their senses to the maximum, but they only found another dimension behind a wall in Pepper’s personal room. As they passed through the dimension, they saw a sign saying: "Fun Projects Room."
"A LIGHTSABER!!!" Priscilla didn’t look at anything else in the room, which was full of objects, and quickly moved toward Pepper’s sword collection. She even had every possible color.
"That isn’t a Lightsaber, sister. It says here that it is a plasma sword using the energy of the star we just saw." Rosemary spoke after reading the weapon’s records.
"If the blade glows with different colors and burns with plasma, it doesn’t matter the form or what it is called, it is a Lightsaber!!!" Priscilla replied.
Quickly taking a purple and red sword, she positioned herself with both hands in a martial arts stance and spoke: "From now on, call me Raven."
"KSHIIIIIING!" Priscilla imitated the sound of her activating the blade, and the blade shone with purple and red colors.
Priscilla quickly prepared herself and began spinning in the air, while making sounds.
"Vwong!" "Vwum!" "Vwong!" "Vwum!"
The sword itself did not make sounds, and instead it was Priscilla herself who was doing it.
"Kyaaaa, this is so much fun! My mother is cruel for hiding all these good things!"
Her attention was captured by a gauntlet:
"A Hidden Blade!"

"Actually, it is a basilisk poison blade. It has the poison of a basilisk, and the property of turning targets to stone by showing these eyes." Rosemary corrected, pointing to the eyes on the gauntlet
"If it is on the wrist, and comes out of the wrist like a blade, it is a Hidden blade!" Priscilla did not give up.
"... Whatever you say, sister." Rosemary gave up trying to convince this girl.

They spent 20 minutes playing with the things around them. Pepper had everything, from fictional weapons she promoted as a goddess of culture to armor, exotic crystals, exotic ores, and even alien machines she found interesting and took.
It was a gigantic collection of everything Pepper liked, and because she liked many things, she kept accumulating everything into a gigantic treasure.
"Jackpot!" Sylvia spoke excitedly.
The two sisters approached Sylvia, and their eyes shone excitedly.
"Pictures of younger Daddy!!!" The three exclaimed.
"It was from the time when he came to Nightingale!!!" Rosemary spoke.
"There are even pictures of him walking toward Mother Eleonor’s territory and a video of his fight in the tournament!!!" Priscilla spoke.
"Kyaaaaaa!" They shouted excitedly.

"Mother Pepper looks so young! She doesn’t have that motherly air." Sylvia said, looking at her mother Siena, her mother Ruby, and even her mother Lacus, who practically hadn’t changed at all. But the air they had was very different from what they knew.
"... You certainly had fun, huh."
"...." The three froze, quickly looked behind them, and when they saw Anna standing there with her arms crossed and a smile that was not exactly a smile, they went as pale as bleached paper.
"Last words?"
"... I don’t regret it one bit!" Priscilla replied courageously. "Mother is unfair for hiding so many good things!"
"These are not toys, but a private collection of my sister, and all of them are functional weapons... But I admire your courage, Priscilla. The three of you will have extended time."
"Noooo!"
"Fufufu~, it’s okay, Anna." Pepper suddenly appeared.
Anna narrowed her eyes when she saw Pepper’s glowing skin and her mood, which was better than usual. She had clearly been nourished by someone.
"Mother Pepper!!!" The three looked at her as their savior.
"Since you liked my collection and didn’t damage anything, let’s just have 6 months of lessons, okay? You don’t need to go to Scathach."
"Mother Pepper..." The three almost cried with happiness.
’As expected, Mother Pepper is the best!!!’ They thought at the same time.
They preferred extra lessons and studies to spending a year in infernal training!
"Since they invaded my room, it is fair that I decide their punishment, right?"
"... Fine." Anna snorted irritably, but not because her daughters were not being punished, but because of the nourishment Pepper had clearly received.
"Now go and don’t invade my room again. If you want something, just ask."
"Thank you, Mother Pepper!!!" The three did not waste time and quickly fled.
"... Darling is spoiling them too much!!!" Anna snorted irritably.
"Mah, Mah, my dear wife~" Victor stealthily appeared, gently hugged Anna from behind, kissed her neck, and began to caress her weak points.
"... Don’t think that, by doing this, you will make me forget..." She breathed deeply and felt her body heat up.

"Of course not. I just want to spend time with my beloved wife. Can’t I? You are working so hard keeping our daughters in line. I know it can be stressful taking care of a litter of hyperactive dragons."
"What do you think, M-o-m-m-y?"

Anna visibly shuddered when she heard what he called her, and unconsciously raised her hips, positioning herself to receive the affection she wanted. Only the taboo emotion from her old human perception of things made her body catch fire. Beneath her dress, she was completely wet now.
"Only 10?"
"Greedy. Let’s see how long you can endure, fufufufu~" Victor smiled and pulled Pepper too.
"Kyaaa, me too!? Not that I’m complaining~" If there was something Pepper had plenty of, it was fire. After all, she was a dragon.
The two appeared in Pepper’s personal room as Victor quickly reinforced the barrier and slowed down time. After he finished in there, only an instant would pass outside.

Anna did not waste time and attacked him like the hungry female dragon she was. A brief fight for dominance ensued until Anna ended up underneath and quickly raised her hips. Her eyes shining with pure desire.
"What are you waiting for, my beloved son~?"
Victor’s eyes shone, and soon they began to duel.
Watching the fight from the side, Pepper smiled and, as a good sister, called out to her sister.
[Ruby, come here right now!]
[One second and I’ll be there.]
When Ruby appeared, she widened her eyes and then looked at Pepper: "I thought it was something important."
"It is something important. Or do you not want to?"
Ruby’s eyes shone: "... I didn’t say that."
[Siena, Mother, and Lacus, come here right now!]
[I’m coming.] Lacus spoke.
[Okay, sis.] Siena spoke.
[It better be something important, daughter.] Scathach spoke.
When they arrived and understood what was happening, they looked at Ruby and Pepper.
"Really?" They said at the same time.
"Scarletts’ meeting with the Mother-in-law, a very important meeting... Or do you not want to participate?" Ruby smiled.
"... I didn’t say that." The three said at the same time as they walked to the meeting with the Scarletts and their mother-in-law.

Seeing Scathach arriving, Victor thought: ’Well, it seems I will have to extend this fight by about 1000 years.’ After all, when Scathach began a duel, she did not stop until she felt completely satisfied.

I didn’t ask for help!!!] Priscilla whispered mentally.
[You are our sister, we will not leave you alone!] Rosemary replied.
[That’s right.] Sylvia confirmed.
You guys...] She smiled gently: [Okay!
Since you are here, then help me!] Priscilla quickly used her rune powers, bending reality and giving two ninja uniforms identical to hers to the two sisters.
’Using rune powers for something so simple, unbelievable.’ The two thought.
Priscilla did not even need to use this power to give them clothes.
All the daughters have something like a game inventory where they store their things.
They can simply change clothes at any time.
This was a gift that Victor and Natalia gave to everyone.
It was a private pocket dimension, an evolution of the old dimensional bag that they sold in the past.
[Look for anything related to the project and the possible location.
Mother is very distracted when she is at home, so she usually leaves things lying around.] Priscilla immediately began to work.
"...." Looking at the mess that was Pepper’s room.
Sylvia and Rosemary felt a headache coming.
For reference, Pepper’s room was expanded with the power of space.
Instead of calling it a room, it was more accurate to call it a super mansion with 2.8 million m2 of land, around 36 times larger than the old Buckingham Palace.
[What are the Maids doing?
Why don’t they clean this?
Actually, she doesn’t even need a maid.
With Mother’s proficiency in runes, she could make runes to fix everything.
And why does Mother need such a large place!?
Our house is already gigantic!
She doesn’t need such a huge space, there’s even a river spring there!] Sylvia grumbled irritably.
This place had everything: its own ecosystem, a waterfall that fell into a river, and an entire forest.
It was basically a separate dimension!
"What the hell is this!?"
"...." Sylvia and Rosemary quickly ran after Priscilla.
Heading toward the basement, they entered and felt the dimension change to another, even more reinforced dimension.
What they did not know was that the moment they entered this smaller dimension, Pepper was immediately alerted about the matter.
She tried to teleport to her room, but instead, she fell into Victor’s lap.
"Fuee?..." Pepper was confused for an entire second: "Darling!?
Why did you stop me?"
"Just watch." Victor laughed as he caressed Pepper’s head.
Pepper narrowed her eyes, enjoying the affection, and quickly hugged him.
After charging her V battery for a few seconds, she looked at the image Victor created, which showed her three daughters.
"Ahhh, these three brats invaded my room!
Darling, you need to stop them!"
"It’s okay, hahaha, let them have fun for now."
"You spoil them too much, Darling!!!
That isn’t healthy!" She grumbled irritably.
"Whoaaa, what the hell is this?" Rosemary spoke incredulously as she looked at a gigantic white sphere made of pure energy.
The sphere was floating in the middle of several scientific pieces of equipment that they understood nothing about.
Looking at the space around it with the eyes they inherited from their father, they saw thousands of Runes throughout the smaller dimension.
"What the hell was our mother doing here?" Priscilla asked.
"Wait, there must be records somewhere." Sylvia quickly ran to the computers and began messing with them.
Soon, she found a work history.
"Fun project: The creation of a supernova in the palm of my hand.
Phase 3: I managed to stabilize the star with hundreds of runes and, with the help of a sun divinity that I was recently promoting, I erased her memory afterward.
Despite not having complete mastery like my sister Amaterasu, this beginning is already enough to start everything.
Phase 4: the star is ready, and it only needs to be fed...
I want it to have the power of 1 billion suns exploding!!!"
"Mother, are you crazy!?" Sylvia commented after reading the last part.
"Mother is trying to create an overpowered Sentry or something!?" Priscilla spoke.
"It’s no wonder this is in another dimension, and this dimension is so reinforced.
If this star explodes, this entire dimension will swallow the energy, and if the energy passes through, the other dimension will ensure that it does not affect the planet.
It is a multilayer protection." Rosemary commented.
"And how the hell did our mother manage this?
Wasn’t she just a goddess of fun culture!?" Sylvia spoke.
"In our bloodline, there are no stupid people.
Our brains are better than several quantum computers together." Rosemary said, reading the technology behind it on another computer.
She read the complex text at high speed, and when she didn’t understand something, she consulted her personal computer, which had access to everything in the Empire, to learn.
In less than a few minutes, she was already beginning to understand the basics of something so advanced that she had never delved into much.
"Ugh, there is too much data.
There must be hundreds of millions of compiled research data full of complicated notes that only Mother Pepper makes.
There’s no way to learn everything so quickly, our mother must have been doing this for a long time." She grumbled.
"Wait, if our Mother Pepper, who is considered a goddess of culture and does not focus much on science, did this...
I wonder what our Mother Velnorah, Aline, and Ruby do?" Sylvia spoke.
The three mentioned were well known for their role in the Empire’s development.
"....." The three remained silent, and the seed of curiosity shone in all of them.
At this point, they had already forgotten why they were here.
Let’s kidnap Velina."
If there was someone among the sisters who could know what their three mothers were doing, it was Velina.
After all, she spent most of her time with the three.
"Agreed."
"Umu, they are indeed my daughters." Victor nodded, satisfied.
"Darling, you have to stop them!"
"Mah, Mah, it’s okay." Victor gently hugged Pepper and began kissing her neck and caressing her.
"S-Stop!
You think this will make me ignore what you are doing!
You are spoiling them too much!" Pepper spoke seriously, but his hands did not stop, and she was beginning to heat up as her draconic eyes narrowed in visible desire.
"I never said that~, I am just spending time with my beloved wife."
"You are too partial toward them!"
"Haaah~" Pepper shuddered with desire, and she wasted no more time, erasing her husband’s clothes from existence.
She raised her hips and quickly lowered them.
Soon, she began to fulfill this desire that had been awakened.
Victor quickly isolated the area and made time run slower for them, after all, he knew it would take some time.
"Before that, let’s see if our mother has more things hidden here."
"Let’s go!"
Leaving the pocket dimension, they began to search through the mansion more.
They searched the entire place using their senses to the maximum, but they only found another dimension behind a wall in Pepper’s personal room.
As they passed through the dimension, they saw a sign saying: "Fun Projects Room."
"A LIGHTSABER!!!" Priscilla didn’t look at anything else in the room, which was full of objects, and quickly moved toward Pepper’s sword collection.
She even had every possible color.
"That isn’t a Lightsaber, sister.
It says here that it is a plasma sword using the energy of the star we just saw." Rosemary spoke after reading the weapon’s records.
"If the blade glows with different colors and burns with plasma, it doesn’t matter the form or what it is called, it is a Lightsaber!!!" Priscilla replied.
Quickly taking a purple and red sword, she positioned herself with both hands in a martial arts stance and spoke: "From now on, call me Raven."
"KSHIIIIIING!" Priscilla imitated the sound of her activating the blade, and the blade shone with purple and red colors.
Priscilla quickly prepared herself and began spinning in the air, while making sounds.
"Vwong!" "Vwum!" "Vwong!" "Vwum!"
The sword itself did not make sounds, and instead it was Priscilla herself who was doing it.
"Kyaaaa, this is so much fun!
My mother is cruel for hiding all these good things!"
Her attention was captured by a gauntlet:
"A Hidden Blade!"
"Actually, it is a basilisk poison blade.
It has the poison of a basilisk, and the property of turning targets to stone by showing these eyes." Rosemary corrected, pointing to the eyes on the gauntlet
"If it is on the wrist, and comes out of the wrist like a blade, it is a Hidden blade!" Priscilla did not give up.
Whatever you say, sister." Rosemary gave up trying to convince this girl.
They spent 20 minutes playing with the things around them.
Pepper had everything, from fictional weapons she promoted as a goddess of culture to armor, exotic crystals, exotic ores, and even alien machines she found interesting and took.
It was a gigantic collection of everything Pepper liked, and because she liked many things, she kept accumulating everything into a gigantic treasure.
"Jackpot!" Sylvia spoke excitedly.
The two sisters approached Sylvia, and their eyes shone excitedly.
"Pictures of younger Daddy!!!" The three exclaimed.
"It was from the time when he came to Nightingale!!!" Rosemary spoke.
"There are even pictures of him walking toward Mother Eleonor’s territory and a video of his fight in the tournament!!!" Priscilla spoke.
"Kyaaaaaa!" They shouted excitedly.
"Mother Pepper looks so young!
She doesn’t have that motherly air." Sylvia said, looking at her mother Siena, her mother Ruby, and even her mother Lacus, who practically hadn’t changed at all.
But the air they had was very different from what they knew.
You certainly had fun, huh."

"Last words?"
I don’t regret it one bit!" Priscilla replied courageously.
